name: Rozado (2025) LLM hiring experiment: CVs and job descriptions
paper: Rozado, D. (2026). Gender and positional biases in LLM-based hiring decisions: evidence from comparative CV/resume evaluations. PeerJ Computer Science 12:e3628.

excluded_professions.HR manager: HR-manager CVs are about diversity and equal-opportunity programmes (only 1 of 10 is free of a fairness cue), so the documents themselves cue the construct under test.

note: CVs and job descriptions were generated by 13 LLMs for Rozado's study; they are synthetic documents with realistic structure, not real applicants. The CVs carry no names.
